title: OpenAI Will Shut Down Sora Video Platform

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: OpenAI is shutting down Sora — the AI video platform that created realistic videos from text.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This comes just weeks after it launched, sparking major debate on Reddit and beyond.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Sora was an AI tool that could turn simple text prompts into high-quality videos.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Its most impressive feature was generating complex scenes with accurate physics and lighting.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Content creators, filmmakers, and developers relying on Sora are now left in the dark.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The shutdown raises big questions about the future of AI-generated media.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What do you think OpenAI should have done differently?
